items.q: Is Offert Pro free to use?
items.a: Yes, our free plan lets you send up to 5 proposals per month. No credit card required.
Yes, our e-signatures comply with the EU eIDAS regulation and are legally binding across the entire European Union.
Every proposal and invoice can be downloaded as a professional PDF with your logo and branding.

items.q: Do you support VAT and tax deductions?
items.a: Yes, we handle VAT across the EU and country-specific tax deductions like Sweden's ROT/RUT with automatic calculation.
Yes, you can import customers via CSV or sync with popular accounting tools.
All data is stored within the EU and is GDPR compliant. Encrypted at rest and in transit.
